summary: Smoke test iteration 5. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (health, trending non-empty, /content/550 title=Fight Club, /content/1399?type=tv 200 no 500, /search?q=matrix has items, admin login returns JWT, /public/sections contains all 4 expected Italian names). Frontend on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: home loads with hero (The Artful Dodger), 7 rows and 49 images rendered, 'Top 10 titoli oggi' text present after scroll, 'I titoli del momento' + 'Aggiunti di recente' visible. Header search icon expands, typing 'matrix' shows RISULTATI dropdown with Matrix / Matrix Reloaded / Revolutions / Resurrections. Clicking 'Altre info' navigates to a detail route /browse/tv/{id} showing title, overview, PANORAMICA/EPISODI/DETTAGLI/TRAILER tabs (page-based, not modal, but functionally matches spec of showing detail with title+overview - Play not pressed). Admin /admin login with admin@admin.com/admin123 redirects to /admin/dashboard showing Dashboard/Contenuti/Hero/Sezioni/Menu/Impostazioni sidebar. No backend errors observed.

issues: Mixed-content warnings: some tmdb image URLs are http://image.tmdb.org/... auto-upgraded to https by browser. Non-blocking but should be normalized to https at source.
Recurring console errors: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19' from a third-party component (likely slick-carousel/MUI ref bridge). Non-blocking, tracked in iter4 too.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Force TMDB image URLs to https to remove mixed-content warnings on detail pages.
(Cosmetic) Track and fix legacy element.ref usage that logs on every render under React 19.
